scope.cache_state: fresh processes; copied/hashed inputs warm an uncontrolled OS file cache; no cold-cache claim
scope.cpu_boundary: wait4 direct-child user+system CPU, including its threads; excludes driver and fixture CPU
scope.engine: real worker/package pins verified; fixture supplies replies; no model or Python compute backend is measured
scope.large_response: fresh native client -> same private deterministic Unix fixture -> byte-identical stdout -> exit
scope.not_sent: four cumulative startup/validation exit paths; exact errors and zero socket connections required
scope.order: per-stage A,B then B,A; even round count forms complete ABBA blocks; no warmup exclusions
scope.retry_policy: no resubmission or retry after failure; raw traces and failed sample retained
scope.rss_boundary: wait4 lifetime ru_maxrss in KiB, may include inherited pre-exec peak; cannot represent post-exec or steady-state memory
scope.source_labels: caller-supplied revision/manifest labels require external build provenance; binary content hashes are measured
scope.stage_differences: descriptive whole-process differences; not isolated hash or parser timings
scope.wall_boundary: perf_counter immediately before Popen through wait4 reap; includes process creation, exec, validation, transport and stdout
scope.wall_excludes: fixture preparation, driver trace validation, input hashing, result persistence and final input recheck
